[Event] {product}: auto mode's safety classifier was briefly unavailable (the service timed out or was busy), so it could not judge whether the operations below are safe, and they were not run. This is not a refusal, and nobody approved these operations.
[Operations held back ({n})]
{ops}
[Reason] Classifier unavailable
[What to do] This is {product}'s automatic retry {round} (at most {max}): retry each operation above once; the retry goes through auto mode's safety check as usual. Do not repeat what already succeeded or is no longer needed; if the classifier is still unavailable, carry on with other work first and do not retry again and again. Never work around an operation that was judged unsafe.
